name: Platform verification and measurement
description:
Establish the facts the rest of the plan depends on. Produces knowledge, not shipped code. Gates design in F002-F005.

BOTH UNKNOWNS ARE NOW ANSWERED. T002 (Android) and T001 (iOS limit) both done 2026-09-08.

MEASURED — THE iOS CALL DIRECTORY LIMIT (T001, iPhone 13 / iPhone14,5, iOS 26.6.1):
Blocking entries: 1,000 OK 0.05s | 1,000,000 OK 7.56s | 1,500,000 OK 9.40s | 1,750,000 OK 13.0s | 1,900,000 OK 12.1s | 2,000,000 FAIL code 5 | 5,000,000 FAIL code 5.
Identification entries (number + label): 1,900,000 OK 47.58s — about 4x the time of blocking entries for the same count.
HARD CAP is between 1.9M and 2M. The design's earlier assumption of ~1,000,000, taken from a competitor's marketing page, was WRONG and too low.
DEFAULT TARGET 1,500,000, agreed with the user: comfortably under the cap, 9.4s, headroom for untested devices.
THE NUMBER MUST NOT BE HARDCODED. Error 5 (MaximumEntriesExceeded) is a clean catchable signal, so the app expands, attempts the load, and backs off on error 5. The measurement is the starting estimate and the basis for warning the user early — not a rule. Whether the cap varies by device or iOS version is UNTESTED (one device only); the clean error rather than a crash suggests a fixed OS cap, but the runtime backoff is what makes that safe.
UNTESTED: whether blocking and identification entries share one cap. Each passed alone at 1.9M; no combined run. Low urgency — R1 and R3 are deferred and release 1 emits no identification entries.

VERIFIED — iOS (SDK 26.2 headers, this machine):
- iOS calls never run app code at call time. CXCallDirectoryProvider.beginRequestWithExtensionContext: is a batch load; CXCallDirectoryExtensionContext offers only addBlockingEntryWithNextSequentialPhoneNumber: and addIdentificationEntryWithNextSequentialPhoneNumber:label:, int64, strictly ascending; CXCall carries no number; CTCallCenter is a deprecated stub; LiveCommunicationKit's cellular API is outgoing-only.
- iOS SMS runs live: ILMessageFilterQueryHandling carries sender, messageBody, receiverISOCountryCode. Verdict caps at Junk.
- No call-history API and no blocked-call callback, so R6 is impossible on iOS.
- A FREE personal team CAN sign AND RUN app extensions on device. Proven end to end (team UY66NT5LGF). Profiles expire in 7 days. A paid account is still required for F004 because App Groups need one.

VERIFIED — Android (sources/android-36, this machine):
- CallScreeningService.onScreenCall(Call.Details) runs at call time; getHandle() gives the tel: URI. CallResponse.Builder: setDisallowCall, setRejectCall, setSilenceCall, setSkipCallLog, setSkipNotification — so a blocked call can show nothing at all, and "show blocked calls or not" becomes a user setting. Role ROLE_CALL_SCREENING; service guarded by BIND_SCREENING_SERVICE.
- FIVE SECOND LIMIT: respondToCall must return within 5s of binding and the phone does not ring until it does. Hard constraint on the core's evaluate().
- CONTACTS EXEMPT BY DEFAULT unless the app holds READ_CONTACTS.
- WITHHELD NUMBERS NEVER REACH THE SERVICE (PRESENTATION_RESTRICTED / UNKNOWN / UNAVAILABLE / PAYPHONE). Cannot be blocked.
- SMS BLOCKING REQUIRES THE DEFAULT SMS APP. Non-default apps get a non-abortable broadcast — observe only. Android SMS is therefore dropped from release 1; see P012(F005) and idea I001.
- NO SYSTEM SPAM LABEL. Android's caller-ID route is our own overlay activity, not text on the system call screen.
- BlockedNumberProvider unusable: system, default SMS app, default dialer and carrier apps only; exact numbers only.
- PLAY POLICY: caller ID / spam blocking is a permitted exception, no default-handler status needed, but requires a Permissions Declaration Form and review. Moot for release 1 now that Android SMS is out.

FOUR BUILD TRAPS FOUND IN T001, all likely to recur in F004:
1. Xcode 26 Debug builds put extension code in a separate __preview.dylib, so the principal class is missing from the appex and enabling fails. Build Release or set ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB=NO.
2. xcodegen's info.path generates a plist and silently drops a hand-written NSExtension dictionary; use info.properties.
3. Incremental requests cause duplicate inserts (sqlite error 19) if you re-add stored numbers. Honour context.isIncremental.
4. Error 7 (CurrentlyLoading) is common after install and during long loads. Retry with a delay.

DEVICE PREREQUISITES: Developer Mode on, developer certificate trusted, and the extension switched on manually in Settings. Until that last step reloadExtension returns error 6 (ExtensionDisabled) — exactly the R4 problem the real app must handle.

DATA: libphonenumber covers 245 territories and 151 countries x 34 languages of geocoding. Measured: 226/244 countries need <=4 digits pinned for mobile, 223/245 for landline.
